# No Publishable Exact-Head COMMENT Review

At the 2026-09-17 readback, PR460 is open, not draft, at
`8f097f409ce85996c7ed062bdaad910023594376` on `main`; nine `local-ci/*`
contexts are green. The seven live review records are bound to earlier heads;
the last, 5207721527, is `CHANGES_REQUESTED` at
`e2b0e9ca7c34a1edf1bdfc52daf6c75694fa4c52`. No marker-bound COMMENT
review or `local-review/summary` exists at the current head.

The independent F1-F10 report (SHA-256
`9feddca884bd347060a8370d69d1201a6e1e7668be895762622720962b63c753`)
explicitly disclaims a full review, approval, and adjudication. It cannot be
attributed a `VERDICT:` line. The operator's checked dispositions are not a
reviewer verdict under trusted `local/protocols/review.md` sections 6, 7, 9,
12 and 13. The first-parent repair `81221e5e` changes seven files after the
operative review, and strict patch identity with an older reviewed head was
neither established nor claimed. Do not manufacture a carried-review marker.

Consequently there is no honest, policy-supported COMMENT review body to
publish from these inputs. Posting `APPROVED` or a ledger-clean `COMMENTED`
verdict with a success status would turn evidence-only disposition into
unearned reviewer approval; inventing unresolved F1-F10 to create an adverse
review would contradict the independent report. Posting only ADJUDICATION
does not fix this: trusted `local/bin/pr_merge.py` gate 4 checks for an
exact-head marker-bound review *before* considering `--adjudicated`, and
the paired review status is still absent.

Required before publication: an authorized policy-valid exact-head reviewer
verdict and paired status, or an actually verified strict-diff carry under
section 13. Neither is present. The current task forbids an eighth full
review, a gate call, and all publication; stop here without a COMMENT body.
